dedupe_keys.name: traffic4cast 2022 competition data london madrid melbourne

description: Traffic4cast 2022 was a NeurIPS competition run by the Institute of Advanced Research in Artificial Intelligence (IARAI) in Vienna. Participants predicted congestion classes (red, yellow, green) and, in the extended challenge, average speeds on every road segment of a city graph 15 minutes ahead, given one hour of sparse vehicle-counter data in 15-minute bins. Coverage: London, Madrid and Melbourne; the labels come from a large probe-vehicle GPS fleet aggregated by HERE Technologies for 2019 to 2021, and the inputs from sparse vehicle counters. Format and access: city archives (London 2.8 GB, Madrid 4.0 GB, Melbourne 0.9 GB) downloaded from HERE's sample data site, with preparation scripts, baselines and the leaderboard in the GitHub repository. Licence and cost: repository code under Apache-2.0; the data are distributed by HERE under its own terms. Caveats: labels are sparse, since GPS fleets cover only part of traffic; the data are aggregated, not raw traces. The set supports city-scale network flow forecasting and tests of graph models that infer link states from few detectors. It relates to the LargeST benchmark and the GB road traffic counts in the catalogue.
